g.text: (b) does each cue move the same birds as far? (same base)
The same birds fall for both cues: birds that conflicting scenes fool are also fooled
by a written word (ρ = 0.39 landbirds, 0.32 waterbirds), and on one shared base the
Both fooled shares track how weakly the bird is recognised on the original image (ρ with the original margin:
scenes -0.52 / -0.36, text -0.85 / -0.86). n = 600 birds per class; 95% CIs resample species.
